report.explanation: Fixture suggestion for the IME draft.

steps.text: IME composition must review the FINAL draft, not intermediates

args.expression: new Promise((resolve) => { const t0 = Date.now(); const tick = () => { if (document.documentElement.hasAttribute('data-skills-armed')) { document.querySelector("button[data-skill-fixture='ime']").click(); return setTimeout(() => resolve({ value: document.querySelector('textarea').value, attr: document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-skills-armed'), types: window.__fixture.log.map((e) => e.type) }), 800); } if (Date.now() - t0 > 5000) return resolve({ armTimeout: true, attr: document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-skills-armed') }); setTimeout(tick, 100); }; tick(); })

new Promise((resolve) => { const t0 = Date.now(); const tick = () => { Promise.resolve().then(() => window.__skillsTest.state()).then((s) => { if (s && s.state === 'suggestion') return resolve({ state: s.state, ms: Date.now() - t0 }); if (Date.now() - t0 > 5000) return resolve({ timeout: true, last: s && s.state }); setTimeout(tick, 250); }).catch(() => { if (Date.now() - t0 > 5000) return resolve({ timeout: true, last: 'error' }); setTimeout(tick, 250); }); }; tick(); })

Promise.resolve().then(() => window.__skillsTest.state()).then((s) => { const card = document.querySelector('.pb-review-card'); window.__fixture.record('diag-card', { state: s && s.state, card: card ? { hidden: card.hidden, buttons: Array.from(card.querySelectorAll('button')).map((b) => ({ text: b.textContent.trim(), disabled: b.disabled })) } : 'noCard' }); return (s && s.state) || 'no-state'; })()

(() => { const card = document.querySelector('.pb-review-card'); if (!card) return window.__fixture.record('diag-auth', { result: 'noCard' }), { noCard: true }; const b = Array.from(card.querySelectorAll('button')).find((x) => x.textContent.includes('Post my text')); if (!b) return window.__fixture.record('diag-auth', { result: 'noBtn' }), { noBtn: true, hidden: card.hidden }; b.click(); window.__fixture.record('diag-auth', { result: 'clicked', disabled: b.disabled }); return 'authorize-requested'; })()

new Promise((resolve) => { const t0 = Date.now(); const tick = () => { Promise.resolve().then(() => window.__skillsTest.state()).then((s) => { if (s && s.state === 'authorized') return resolve({ state: s.state, ms: Date.now() - t0 }); if (Date.now() - t0 > 5000) return resolve({ timeout: true, last: s && s.state }); setTimeout(tick, 250); }).catch(() => { if (Date.now() - t0 > 5000) return resolve({ timeout: true, last: 'error' }); setTimeout(tick, 250); }); }; tick(); })

(() => { document.querySelector("button[data-skill-fixture='submit']").click(); return new Promise((r) => setTimeout(() => r({ submitted: document.body.getAttribute('data-submitted'), receipt: (document.getElementById('receipt') || {}).textContent || null, types: window.__fixture.log.map((e) => e.type) }), 800)); })()
